plan: My private value is $30. In a single-round auction with independent values, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically near my value. Since other bidders have unknown values, I want to maximize my potential profit. A bid slightly below my value (around $25-$28) gives me a buffer against potential losses while still having a good chance of winning. This minimizes downside risk while preserving upside potential.

Since I want to maximize potential profit, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A bid around $25 gives me potential profit if I win, while protecting against overbidding. This allows me to potentially win the item if other bidders bid lower, and ensures I don't pay more than the item is worth to me.
